texts.1) Busca por cualquier dato o utiliza lo:
1) Search for any data or use the filters to locate contacts.
2) Add, modify, or delete contacts; you can also import and export JSON.
3) Filter and mark the recipients you want to include.
4) The version is optional and only serves for internal history.
5) 'Prepare with mailto' opens a single email with the selected recipients in BCC.
6) After sending it, come back here and confirm the actual send to register it.
7) In 'Tools' you can recover contacts from the trash, check the history, and review possible duplicates.
8) In 'Backups' you can save or recover contacts and history together.

IMPORTANT: The manager DOES NOT send emails, does not save passwords, and does not include a subject or message in the mailto link. Private JSONs are saved in local AppData.

texts.1) Busca, filtra y marca los contactos q:
1) Search, filter and mark the contacts you need.
2) For a group you can keep the existing BCC system.
3) To send one by one, open 'Individual Campaign', write the subject and body, add the files and create the queue.
4) 'Prepare Next' opens a single draft in the user's default app and account.
5) Review the message and tap Send personally. Then confirm the shipment in the manager.
6) The next one is enabled after {0} seconds and the manager stops when it reaches {1} confirmed in the day.
7) You can pause, close and continue the queue later without repeating recipients.
8) DO NOT CONTACT, the trash and those who already received the version are excluded.
9) Backups include contacts, history and saved campaign.

IMPORTANT: The manager does not automatically send or save passwords. Opening a draft never marks it as sent.
